zero state mutation on any gateway surface RT-03 obligation padding 50 trivial obligations satisfied / always-outstanding count->level mapping NONE < LOW (all satisfied) < MED < HIGH (≥2 outstanding) ❌ priority inversion BLOCKED — satisfied padding LOWERS priority; outstanding padding caps at HIGH (parity) -> created_at 2 regression tests satisfied-loses + outstanding-parity ◆ REFUTED (live probe + regression-locked) * the mapping is anti-Goodhart by ratified contract RT-04 SUCCEEDED masking A FAILED -> B fallback SUCCEEDED C executes on B's fallback outputs cone = hard-blocking predicate SUCCEEDED intermediate breaks propagation (by contract) provenance truthfulness B's artifacts link to B (real producer) masking is visibility-only A's cone + re-review candidates surface in the SAME digest as B's outputs ◆ PARTIALLY VALID, BY DESIGN * residual: edge-propagation policy / soft-dependency kind — FUTURE DESIGN (review §19) RT-05 hazard drift structurally-valid "unavailable" page provider API drift, 200 OK deterministic hazard specs drift sentinel * required_fields * value-semantics markers structured hazard only no semantic authority at the ingestion boundary defense-in-depth downstream garbage-but-valid content still lands as an artifact -> provenance + review + human gate ◆ CONFIRMED AS DESIGN * any drift detector would reintroduce the forbidden LLM dependency — FUTURE DESIGN if ever built F14 forged journal events forged event rows direct SQL into the journal one-verdict journal check keyed on gate task_id (F6/F9) ❌ tamper can only deny forged GatePassed -> one-verdict key, forged resolve -> ALREADY_RESOLVED test_11_forged_gate_events _can_refuse_but_never_authorize ◆ REFUTED (TEST-VERIFIED) * journal tampering can only DENY a verdict — it can never grant one (second resolve refused: NOT_WAITING) VERDICT: 3 refuted + test-verified * 1 test-pinned impossible * 2 accepted design with recorded residuals * 0 defects * no BLOCKER, no MUST FIX external closure attacks the refined directives (forge SourceRetracted -> ladder must not move; wrong class -> never state mutation; count-mapping extremes; forged journal events -> refuse, never authorize)
